HYBRID WORK POLICY (v1)
=======================

OVERVIEW
- Standard schedule: 3 days in office, 2 days remote.

REQUIREMENTS
- VPN is required for remote work.
- MFA is required for VPN access.

EXCEPTIONS
- Managers may approve fully remote arrangements on a case-by-case basis.

POLICY EXCERPT
Employees must protect company data by following security guidelines when working remotely.
